bookSourceComment: 封面：百度图片代理原样保留（站点自有国内通道）；其余统一归一到 fffgood.com。正文沿用 v2 纯 JS base64 解码。
exploreUrl:
<js>
var host = "https://www.netflixgc.com";
var channels = { "🎬 电影": 1, "📺 电视剧": 2, "🧸 漫剧": 3, "🎭 综艺": 23, "🎞️ 纪录片": 24 };
var currentChannel = '🎬 电影';
try {
  var saved = source.getVariable();
  if (saved) {
    var obj = JSON.parse(saved);
    if (obj.channel) currentChannel = obj.channel;
  }
} catch(e) {}
var cid = channels[currentChannel] || 1;

var filters = {
  "类型": {
    "1": ["全部","喜剧","爱情","恐怖","动作","科幻","剧情","犯罪","奇幻","悬疑","惊悚","家庭","冒险","同性","运动","战争","灾难","NETFLIX","HBO","BBC ONE","HULU","APPLE TV","FOX"],
    "2": ["全部","古装","战争","青春偶像","喜剧","爱情","家庭","犯罪","动作","奇幻","剧情","历史","经典","乡村","情景","商战","恐怖","悬疑","惊悚","冒险","同性","运动","灾难","NETFLIX","HBO","BBC ONE","HULU","APPLE TV","FOX","NBC","其他"],
    "3": ["全部","搞笑","热血","催泪","后宫","机战","致郁","百合","推理","校园","音乐","社团","装通","战斗","日常","恋爱","冒险","魔幻","喜剧","动作","奇幻","剧情","动画","科幻","NETFLIX"],
    "23": ["全部","真人秀","搞笑","音乐","冒险","爱情","喜剧","脱口秀","NETFLIX"],
    "24": ["全部","人物","军事","历史","文化","探索","科技","自然","剧情","纪录片","NETFLIX"]
  },
  "地区": {
    "1": ["全部","中国","大陆","香港","台湾","美国","韩国","日本","泰国","新加坡","马来西亚","印度","英国","法国","瑞典","瑞士","乌克兰","加拿大","西班牙","俄罗斯","其它"],
    "2": ["全部","中国","大陆","香港","台湾","美国","韩国","日本","泰国","新加坡","马来西亚","印度","英国","法国","瑞典","瑞士","乌克兰","加拿大","西班牙","俄罗斯","其它"],
    "3": ["全部","日本","美国","其他"],
    "23": ["全部","美国","日本","韩国"],
    "24": ["全部","美国","日本","韩国","英国"]
  },
  "年份": {
    "1": ["全部","2026","2025","2024","2023","2022","2021","2020","2019","2018","2017","2016","2015","2014","2013","2012","2011","2010","2009","2008","2007","2006","2005","2004","2003","2002","2001","2000","1999","1998","1997","1996","1995","1994","1993","1992","1991","1990","其他"],
    "2": ["全部","2026","2025","2024","2023","2022","2021","2020","2019","2018","2017","2016","2015","2014","2013","2012","2011","2010","2009","2008","2007","2006","2005","2004","2003","2002","2001","2000"],
    "3": ["全部","2026","2025","2024","2023","2022","2021","2020","2019","2018","2017","2016","2015","2014","2013","2012","2011","2010","2009","2008","2007","2006","2005","2004","2003","2002","2001","2000","1999","1998","1997","1996","1995","1994","1993","1992","1991","1990","其他"],
    "23": ["全部","2026","2025","2024","2023","2022","2021","2020","2019","2018","2017","2016","2015","2014","2013","2012","2011","其他"],
    "24": ["全部","2026","2025","2024","2023","2022","2021","2020","2019","2018","2017","2016","2015","2014","2013","2012","2011","其他"]
  },
  "语言": {
    "1": ["全部","中文","粤语","闽南语","英语","日语","韩语","法语","俄语","德语","泰语","瑞典语","印度语"],
    "2": ["全部","中文","国语","粤语","闽南语","英语","日语","韩语","法语","俄语","德语","泰语","瑞典语","印度语","其它"],
    "3": ["全部","日语","英语"],
    "23": ["全部","英语","日语","韩语"],
    "24": ["全部","英语","日语","韩语"]
  }
};

var ui = [
  { title: '关键字', type: 'text', default: '', style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1 } },
  { title: '🔍 搜剧', type: 'button', action: "var k=infoMap['关键字']; if(!k){ java.toast('请输入影片名称'); } else { java.searchBook(k, source); }", style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1 } },
  { title: '频道切换', type: 'select', chars: Object.keys(channels), default: currentChannel, action: "var c=infoMap['频道切换']; var obj={}; try{obj=JSON.parse(source.getVariable());}catch(e){} obj.channel=c; source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(obj)); java.refreshExplore(); java.toast('已切换到: '+c);", style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1 } }
];

function pushTag(group, name, urlStr) {
  ui.push({ title: name, url: urlStr, style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.2 } });
}

var sorts = [{name: "按最新", val: "time"}, {name: "按最热", val: "hits"}, {name: "按评分", val: "score"}];
ui.push({ title: '👇 【排行榜】', url: '', style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1, layout_flexGrow: 1 } });
sorts.forEach(function(s) {
  var apiBody = "type="+cid+"&class=&area=&year=&lang=&letter=&by="+s.val+"&page={{page}}";
  var apiUrl = host + "/index.php/ds_api/vod,{\"method\":\"POST\",\"body\":\"" + apiBody + "\"}";
  pushTag("排行", s.name, apiUrl);
});

ui.push({ title: '👇 【按类型】', url: '', style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1, layout_flexGrow: 1 } });
(filters["类型"][cid] || []).forEach(function(c) {
  var cPath = c === "全部" ? "" : encodeURIComponent(c);
  var apiBody = "type="+cid+"&class="+cPath+"&area=&year=&lang=&letter=&by=time&page={{page}}";
  var apiUrl = host + "/index.php/ds_api/vod,{\"method\":\"POST\",\"body\":\"" + apiBody + "\"}";
  pushTag("类型", c, apiUrl);
});

ui.push({ title: '👇 【按地区】', url: '', style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1, layout_flexGrow: 1 } });
(filters["地区"][cid] || []).forEach(function(a) {
  var aPath = a === "全部" ? "" : encodeURIComponent(a);
  var apiBody = "type="+cid+"&class=&area="+aPath+"&year=&lang=&letter=&by=time&page={{page}}";
  var apiUrl = host + "/index.php/ds_api/vod,{\"method\":\"POST\",\"body\":\"" + apiBody + "\"}";
  pushTag("地区", a, apiUrl);
});

ui.push({ title: '👇 【按年份】', url: '', style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1, layout_flexGrow: 1 } });
(filters["年份"][cid] || []).forEach(function(y) {
  var yPath = y === "全部" ? "" : y;
  var apiBody = "type="+cid+"&class=&area=&year="+yPath+"&lang=&letter=&by=time&page={{page}}";
  var apiUrl = host + "/index.php/ds_api/vod,{\"method\":\"POST\",\"body\":\"" + apiBody + "\"}";
  pushTag("年份", y, apiUrl);
});

ui.push({ title: '👇 【按语言】', url: '', style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1, layout_flexGrow: 1 } });
(filters["语言"][cid] || []).forEach(function(l) {
  var lPath = l === "全部" ? "" : encodeURIComponent(l);
  var apiBody = "type="+cid+"&class=&area=&year=&lang="+lPath+"&letter=&by=time&page={{page}}";
  var apiUrl = host + "/index.php/ds_api/vod,{\"method\":\"POST\",\"body\":\"" + apiBody + "\"}";
  pushTag("语言", l, apiUrl);
});

JSON.stringify(ui);
</js>
